messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty SEV2 -> streaming: EU region p99 tail spike on SSE /ws endpoints. Alert: high client stalls, increased 499/502 from upstream proxy. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC-8742 :rotating_light:

laura (eng-runtime): seeing this too, just got paged. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~600ms, p99s at ~11-13s for streaming responses. Lots of small customers complaining about stalls. Sending traces.

mike (sre-oncall): oncall here — I'll take lead. tag me @laura if you have quick triage notes. First ask: is this isolated to a specific proxy fleet or across all EU?

laura (eng-runtime): initial look — error rate concentrated on proxy pool sse-proxy-eu-1/2. Upstream app pods healthy (no OOMs). Metrics: backend request latency normal, but proxy shows increasing write queue lengths and repeated socket timeouts.

devin (eng-runtime): past 15m we see repeated "upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream" in nginx logs and many 499 from clients when the proxy holds connection. log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T10:12:34Z] sse-proxy-eu-1 nginx: 499 client closed connection: client: 10.2.5.123, server: _, request: "GET /v1/stream?id=...", upstream: "http://10.3.4.56:8080/stream", host: "api.redwood.ai"
[2026-03-15T10:12:39Z] sse-proxy-eu-1 nginx: 502 bad gateway while reading response header from upstream
```

anya (support): got customers pinging CS asking why live updates stop then resume. Affected: AcmeApp, Chatly (EU customers). Escalating to account owners.

mike (sre-oncall): ok mitigation plan: 1) temporarily divert new EU streaming traffic to sse-proxy-eu-bak pool (smaller pool but healthy) 2) restart sse-proxy-eu-1 to clear stuck connections 3) increase proxy upstream_read_timeout to 90s for streaming route and enable chunked transfer buffering off. I'll run steps 1+2 now.

ops-bot: Routing change executed: traffic split 80/20 -> sse-proxy-eu-bak. Command: `kubectl patch svc sse-eu --patch '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'` (dry-run complete).

mike (sre-oncall): rolling restart started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/sse-proxy-eu-1` — watching logs.

laura (eng-runtime): while restart is in progress, I pushed a hotfix to proxy config: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 90s; keepalive_timeout 65;` for the streaming location. Will roll this to sse-proxy-eu-bak too.

devin (eng-runtime): after restart observed immediate drop in 499/502. client stall rate down ~70% in the last 2 minutes. p99 dropped from ~12s to ~600ms. Looks like the proxy was queuing old connections and hitting keepalive/socket edge cases under high fanout.

mike (sre-oncall): good. Temporary mitigation successful. Next: revert traffic split once config is at parity across pools. Will keep 20% on bak for additional headroom for 15m.

anya (support): customers updated: CS sent interim message to AcmeApp + Chatly that we mitigated an EU streaming disruption and are investigating root cause. No billing impact expected.

laura (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause hypothesis: a recent change to proxy tuning (deployed 3 days ago) decreased keepalive timeout and changed buffer allocation which increased TLS session churn + ephemeral sockets in CLOSE_WAIT on the proxy host under sustained fanout. That caused more socket-level timeouts and client disconnects (499). We'll need to run a config diff and revert the aggressive tuning in the next deploy.

mike (sre-oncall): actions logged:
- Mitigation: restarted sse-proxy-eu-1, applied buffering/timeout overrides (mike).
- Routing: split traffic to bak pool (ops-bot).
- Customer comms: anya/support on interim message.
- Post-incident: eng-runtime will prepare config diff + load test (laura/devin).

devin (eng-runtime): I'll run targeted replay load for long-lived SSE connections to reproduce and validate. Plan: 10k connections with varied keepalive and chunk sizes.

mike (sre-oncall): monitoring watch: enable 1s granularity dashboards for streaming tail, and create alert for p99 > 2s (currently set to 15s historically). I'll create a short-lived alert channel to mobile.

ops-bot: Watch created: streaming-tail-watch-eu (3 seats).

laura (eng-runtime): also saw a small number of proxy worker processes stuck in accept() with high FD counts — likely file descriptor leak under the old config. We'll add ulimit checks and FD metrics to the proxy dashboard.

anya (support): owners looped in: @account-acme assigned to Sam, @chatly-owner assigned to Priya. Both notified.

mike (sre-oncall): status update in 10m. If things stay stable for 20m, we'll demote to follow-up and open a postmortem ticket.

incident-bot: Reminder: SEV2 ongoing. Pager duty escalation policy next in 12m if issue not resolved.

laura (eng-runtime): 20m check: metrics stable, p99 ~550ms, error rate back to baseline. I'll start a config rollback PR to revert the aggressive tuning change and run canary.

devin (eng-runtime): replay test reproduces the issue when we apply previous tuning flags; with rollback flags we don't see the fd growth or worker accept stalls. Will attach logs to postmortem.

mike (sre-oncall): handoff: I'll keep watch for another 30m then hand to morning oncall for postmortem follow-up. Recording customer impact: 2026-03-15T10:12:00Z -> 10:36:00Z approximate. Affected customers: AcmeApp, Chatly, a set of small EU users (~3% of connections experienced stalls >5s).

anya (support): case notes updated.

mike (sre-oncall): closing timeline: mitigation done, follow-ups: config rollback PR, load test validation, add FD & accept metrics, update runbook for SSE proxy long-lived connections. I'll create the JIRA with link in thread.

ops-bot: JIRA created: INF-3241 - "EU SSE proxy: investigate keepalive/buffer tuning causing tail stalls" https://jira.example/INF-3241

laura (eng-runtime): adding runbook item: when p99 >2s AND 499 rate > 0.5% for streaming endpoints, trigger probe to verify proxy FD counts and restart affected pods.

mike (sre-oncall): thanks all. If anything regresses ping me. I'll update the incident (PagerDuty) to resolved in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owners: laura (eng-runtime), mike (sre-oncall), devin (eng-runtime), anya (support).
